Question 6
?

Let B={b1,b2,b3} be a basis of R3 and [x]B=[4−4−7]. What are the coordinates of x relative to the basis C={c1,c2,c3}, where c1=b1, c2=b3 and c3=−b2?

a
[x]C=[4−74]
b
[x]C=[474]
c
[x]C=[4−4−7]
d
[x]C=[74−4]
e
[x]C=[−7−44]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since [x]B=[4−4−7], we can write x as follows:

x=4b1−4b2−7b3=4b1−7b3−4b2=4(b1)−7(b3)+4(−b2)=4c1−7c2+4c3

Therefore, [x]C=[4−74].
